basics.name: Abdul Rehman
basics.label: Senior Full-Stack Engineer & Cloud Architect
basics.summary: Forward-thinking Full-Stack Engineer with 5+ years of experience designing and deploying scalable, high-performance web applications, distributed microservices, and modern user experiences. Passionate about clean architecture, developer tooling, and cloud automation.

work.summary: Lead engineer architecting next-generation distributed SaaS platforms and high-throughput real-time APIs.
highlights: Architected an event-driven data streaming engine handling 12M+ daily events using Node.js, Kafka, and Redis.
Refactored legacy monolith into modular TypeScript microservices, reducing deployment latency by 65%.
Mentored a team of 8 junior and mid-level engineers, establishing company-wide CI/CD standards and code review practices.

work.summary: Engineered customer-facing cloud management dashboards and robust backend services with 99.98% uptime.
highlights: Constructed intuitive real-time monitoring dashboards in React, eliminating 40% of internal incident triage tickets.
Optimized complex PostgreSQL queries and database indexing, slashing p99 latency from 1.2s to 180ms.
Integrated multi-tenant OAuth2/SSO authorization flows for enterprise customers (Okta, Azure AD, Google Workspace).

work.summary: Built high-performance, accessible web interfaces and design systems for enterprise clients.
highlights: Designed and published an internal design system component library adopted across 14 commercial client web apps.
Achieved 100/100 Google Lighthouse scores across Core Web Vitals (LCP, CLS, FID) on flagship client e-commerce portals.
Built responsive, accessible cross-browser animations and interactive data visualizations using modern CSS and Canvas.
